# Northwind Logistics (NWND): Buy

Northwind Logistics is a Buy at $182.40. I value it at $268.00. At today's price you earn about 11.2% a year if my forecast is right, against the 8.2% this stock should earn for its risk. I would buy below $214.40 and sell above $321.60. (Sample report: the company and every number are fictional.)

Northwind runs regional warehouses and next-day trucking for mid-size online sellers. Its contracts run three years and renew at higher prices, and it is opening four new hubs. The main uncertainty is whether a price war with larger carriers squeezes its margins.

## The business

Sellers pay Northwind to store goods and ship them within a day. It wins on speed in regions the big carriers serve slowly. Most customers sign three-year contracts.

## What the company is betting on

Northwind is betting that four new hubs fill within two years. Each hub costs about $60 million and earns its cost back in roughly five years once full.

## What the price asks you to believe

The price assumes growth slows to about 3% a year and margins slip. My middle case expects 8% growth for five years as the new hubs fill, then a fade.

## How wrong I could be

In my bad case, a price war cuts margins in half and a share is worth $150. In my good case, the hubs fill early and a share is worth $410. Confidence is Medium.

## What would change my mind

Up: two new hubs above 80% full by next year. Down: contract renewals at lower prices.

**The numbers**

| | |
|---|---|
| Call | Buy |
| Price | $182.40 |
| My value | $268.00 |
| Buy below / sell above | $214.40 / $321.60 |
| Confidence | Medium |

This is analysis for the owner's own decisions. It is not licensed financial advice.
